title: On Focusing all attention on one child
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：focus　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 focus 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the tailor ① focused all attention on one child with great care, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② focuses all attention on one child on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ focus all attention on one child at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ focused all attention on one child before — a line in the order for November 1942 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Focusing all attention on one child with great care, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ focus the glass on the far bank on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Focus the glass on the far bank at once and never mention it again.

By 1955 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ focuses the glass on the far bank with great care every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ focused all attention on one child again when nobody else would.

⑩ To focus all attention on one child, my mother said in 1960, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody focuses all attention on one child on the same day again and somebody must focus all attention on one child with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 集中（一般过去式 focused all attention on one child：1948 年裁缝头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 集中（一般现在 focuses all attention on one child：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 集中（不定式 to focus all attention on one child：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 集中（过去完成时 had focused all attention on one child：1942 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 集中（动名词 focusing all attention on one child 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 聚焦（focus the glass on the far bank：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去聚焦把镜片对准对岸）
G. v. 聚焦（focus the glass on the far bank：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 集中（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 focuses the glass on the far bank，而母亲又一次 focused all attention on one child）

answers.why: focus 意为“集中”，1948 年裁缝小心翼翼地集中把注意力全放在一个孩子身上，那是裁缝铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 focused。
focus 意为“集中”，自那以后裁缝当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 focuses。
focus 意为“集中”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯集中把注意力全放在一个孩子身上”，此处为不定式 to focus all attention on one child。
focus 意为“集中”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1955 年之前就有人集中过，故用过去完成时 had focused。
focus 意为“集中”，裁缝说“集中把注意力全放在一个孩子身上这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 focusing all attention on one child 作主语。
focus 意为“聚焦”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去聚焦把镜片对准对岸”，should ever 之后用原形 focus the glass on the far bank。
focus 意为“聚焦”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻聚焦把镜片对准对岸（focus the glass on the far bank at once），以后再也不要提起。
focus 意为“集中”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例聚焦把镜片对准对岸，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 focuses。
focus 意为“集中”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地集中把注意力全放在一个孩子身上，用一般过去式 focused 叙述。
focus 意为“集中”，结尾那句是母亲 1960 年的话：要集中把注意力全放在一个孩子身上，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 focus 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the tailor focused all attention on one child with great care, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor focuses all attention on one child on the same day whenever the shop asks.
Focusing all attention on one child with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever focus the glass on the far bank on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop focuses the glass on the far bank with great care every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother focused all attention on one child again, and the shop remembered that half.
